system.description:
This skill may only be used when you and no more than one enemy are in the same square. You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq (the target may not [Hinder] this movement). At the same time as your movement, the target makes a [Safe Move (forced)] to the same square.

A special skill that breaks the target's center of gravity and pushes or pulls it, allowing it to move freely along with the resisting enemy.
